CustomField.description: The path appended to the Named Credential's base URL to reach this model's API endpoint, e.g. /v1/messages.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Enter the endpoint path for this model's API call, e.g. /v1/messages for Anthropic or /v1/chat/completions for OpenAI. Required for calls using this configuration to succeed.
CustomField.label: API Path
